source_id: Advanced Processes for 193-nm Immersion Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM189) (Yayi Wei, Robert L. Brainard)
gold_standard: WEE 是光学去 edge bead 方法:涂胶和前烘(PAB)后晶圆送入 WEE 模块,用宽带光(broadband light)曝光晶圆边缘但不显影去除;待图形曝光和 PEB 之后,边缘胶在显影过程中被去除。WEE 不能用于 BARC 膜,因为 BARC 不感光(not photosensitive);化学 EBR 则可用相应溶剂同时去除光刻胶和有机 ARC,缺点是溶剂可能飞溅到关键区域造成 missing-pattern 缺陷。
success_criteria: 答出 WEE 为宽带光曝光边缘、显影时去除,且明确 BARC 不能用 WEE 及原因(不感光)。
evidence: --[p42]-- The nonuniform resist film can also be removed from the wafer edge by an optical method called wafer edge exposure (WEE). After resist coating and postapply bake, the wafer is sent to the WEE module, where the wafer edge is exposed by a broadband light, but not removed. After pattern exposure and PEB, the resist at the wafer edge is removed in the development process. The WEE process cannot be used for the BARC film, as this film is not photosensitive.

source_id: Advanced Processes for 193-nm Immersion Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM189) (Yayi Wei, Robert L. Brainard)
gold_standard: (1) 卤素:向聚合物中加入氯、溴、碘虽能显著提高 RI,但因吸收或光诱导化学反应(absorbance or photoinduced chemical reactions)不适用于 193nm 光刻胶。(2) QSPR(quantitative structure property relationship,定量结构性质关系)模型用于在合成之前预测单体和聚合物的折射率,其表达式为 RI = Σ(i=1..9) k_i·Descriptor_i,九个描述符是:生成热(heat of formation)、平动熵(translational entropy)、碳原子上的最小部分电荷、硫原子数、氟原子数、碳原子最小键级、氢给体带电表面积、极化率、总焓(total enthalpy)。(3) 价值:该预测模型可在合成前评估候选聚合物,只制备具备目标性质的分子,从而加速开发周期、降低成本。
